The fine print

Privacy Policy

Effective November 18, 2026.

Who runs this site

The Seoul Table (https://gochujang.net) is operated by Oak and Main Developers LLC, 1223 Cleveland Ave, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92103. For anything on this page, or to exercise a privacy right, email admin@oakandmain.dev.

What stays in your browser

There are no accounts and no sign-in. Recipes you save, and the ingredients you tick off on a recipe, are kept in your browser's local storage on the device you use. They are never sent to us, and clearing this site's data in your browser removes them.

Analytics

We use these tools to count visits and see which pages are read:

  • Google Analytics 4, loaded through Cloudflare Zaraz
  • Cloudflare Web Analytics (no cookies)

Google Analytics records approximate location, device and browser type, the referring page and the pages you view, and sets first-party cookies holding a random identifier. Cloudflare Web Analytics counts page views without cookies. We do not use these tools to identify you, we run no advertising, and we do not sell this data. You can block cookies in your browser.

Links to other sites

Some pages link to other websites, such as our companion site KBBQGuide. Those sites have their own privacy practices. The site carries no affiliate links today; if we add any, this policy will say so first.

Hosting

The site is hosted on Vercel and delivered through Cloudflare. Both process your IP address and request details to deliver and protect the site, under their own privacy policies.

Email you send

If you email us, we receive your address and what you write, and use it only to reply.

Your choices and rights

We hold no account or profile for you, so there is usually nothing of yours to show, correct or delete. Write to admin@oakandmain.dev and we will tell you plainly what exists. Depending on where you live, including California, you may have rights to access, correct or delete personal data and to opt out of its sale or sharing. We do not sell or share personal information.

Children

This site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Changes

When this policy changes, the effective date at the top changes with it.
